records.title: Node and Laravel page runtime
records.description: Independent Node and Laravel page hosts support props, forms, navigation, layouts, resume and streaming. Production Laravel renders prebuilt artifacts without Node. Page-owned requests end with the visit; layout-owned resources follow their owner. Rebuild Maraca bundles and page manifests with the same framework version. XTend.store demonstrates Maraca, Laravel, a guest cart and a separate DemoPay provider.

records.title: Page Wire compact transport and CSP
records.description: Opt-in xtend.page-wire.v1 reduces repeated page data. Conditional views materialize only their active branch. Trusted component styles can inherit the document nonce. Preserve the documented host ownership, transport and trust contracts when configuring page delivery.

records.title: XTend 0.8.0 ecosystem verification
records.description: Verify code, types, exports, bilingual docs and actual packaged artifacts together. Accept xtend.maraca.plan-runtime.v3 and xtend.rmt.presentation-effect-adapter.v2 where schema IDs are checked. fastpass.schema.json is additive; the released RMT v2 document schema is unchanged. Test focus through slotted and remote controls, Escape and restoration during hydration and fast surface switches. Docs language switches must update both search and navigation. The shared test catalog and run-bound artifacts define local and CI evidence.

records.title: XTend 0.8.0 scheduler migration
records.description: One shared RMT microkernel owns scheduling. Canonical lanes are user-blocking, visible, transition, idle, background and diagnostics. Jobs return cancellable, thenable RmtJobHandles. Paint, idle and postTask waits release the execution slot until ready. inline/runInline no longer bypass the queue; Product Surface and prewarm require opt-in; ESM imports do not boot a runtime. Fabric supplies work intents and backpressure, not another scheduler.

recipes.title: Guard asynchronous presentation commits
recipes.intent: Integrate custom host adapters with automatic Maraca surface epochs; keep business ownership separate.
steps: Read docs/en/maraca-fastpass-abort-boundary.md and docs/en/hydration-policies.md before writing host adapter code.
Capture a token from runtime.getSurfaceBoundary(id) before asynchronous work. Pass abortBoundary and presentationToken to requestUiCompute; hydration receives metadata.surfaces guards.
After each response check token validity. Return on superseded; never start synchronous rendering fallback.
Use boundary.scheduleCommit(scheduler, work, token) for scheduled commits or boundary.commit(work, token) for synchronous mutation. Recheck immediately before creating DOM/chart resources.
Exercise close/reopen, parent disposal, late worker responses and failed lifecycle operations. Keep shared cached data and business services under their existing owners.

recipes.title: FastPass shell actions
recipes.intent: Declare execution fastpass for navigation, focus and named close on user-blocking. dispatchFastPass returns a cancellable RmtJobHandle; dispatchCommand keeps its Promise. No reducers, services, resources or business effects. Completion acknowledges shell intent, not loading or animation; synchronous work still needs cooperative chunking.
